127  def parse_frozen_agent_spec(
  128      resolved_spec: Mapping[str, Any], *, workspace_id: UUID
  129  ) -> FrozenAgentSpec:
  130      if not isinstance(resolved_spec, Mapping):
  131          raise _invalid_binding()
  132      schema_version = resolved_spec.get("spec_schema_version")
  133      if (
  134          isinstance(schema_version, bool)
  135          or not isinstance(schema_version, int)
  136          or schema_version not in SUPPORTED_SPEC_SCHEMA_VERSIONS
  137      ):
  138          raise _invalid_binding()
  139      model = resolved_spec.get("model")
  140      prompt = resolved_spec.get("prompt")
  141      if not isinstance(model, Mapping) or not isinstance(prompt, Mapping):
  142          raise _invalid_binding()
  143      primary = _parse_profile(model, workspace_id=workspace_id, primary=True)
  144      fallback_values = model.get("fallback_profiles", [])
  145      if not isinstance(fallback_values, list):
  146          raise _invalid_binding()
  147      fallbacks = tuple(
  148          _parse_profile(item, workspace_id=workspace_id, primary=False) for item in fallback_values
  149      )
  150      retry_value = model.get("retry_policy", {"max_attempts": 1})
  151      if not isinstance(retry_value, Mapping):
  152          raise _invalid_binding()
  153      try:
  154          retry_policy = RetryPolicy(max_attempts=int(retry_value.get("max_attempts", 1)))
  155      except (TypeError, ValueError):
  156          raise _invalid_binding() from None
  157      system_prompt = prompt.get("system_prompt", prompt.get("system"))
  158      prompt_version = prompt.get("prompt_version", prompt.get("version", 1))
  159      if (
  160          not isinstance(system_prompt, str)
  161          or not system_prompt
  162          or not isinstance(prompt_version, int)
  163      ):
  164          raise _invalid_binding()
  165      retrieval = resolved_spec.get("retrieval", {})
  166      if not isinstance(retrieval, Mapping):
  167          raise _invalid_binding()
  168      knowledge_bindings = _parse_knowledge_bindings(retrieval, schema_version)
  169      wiki_binding = _parse_wiki_binding(resolved_spec)
  170      runtime_value = resolved_spec.get("runtime", {})
  171      if not isinstance(runtime_value, Mapping):
  172          raise _invalid_binding()
  173      runtime: dict[str, Any] = {}
  174      for key, default in _DEFAULT_RUNTIME.items():
  175          value = runtime_value.get(key, default)
  176          if (
  177              isinstance(value, bool)
  178              or not isinstance(value, int)
  179              or not 1 <= value <= MAX_RUNTIME_LIMITS[key]
  180          ):
  181              raise _invalid_binding()
  182          runtime[key] = value
  183      # The cost ceiling is carried across the freeze boundary by hand rather than
  184      # with the scalar limits above: it is the one runtime value that may legally
  185      # be absent, and a published ceiling the executing spec does not carry is a
  186      # ceiling that does nothing.
  187      cost_limit = runtime_value.get("max_cost_micro_usd")
  188      if cost_limit is not None and (
  189          isinstance(cost_limit, bool)
  190          or not isinstance(cost_limit, int)
  191          or not 1 <= cost_limit <= MAX_RUN_COST_LIMIT_MICRO_USD
  192      ):
  193          raise _invalid_binding()
  194      runtime["max_cost_micro_usd"] = cost_limit
  195      context_budget_value = runtime_value.get("context_budget", _DEFAULT_CONTEXT_BUDGET)
  196      if not isinstance(context_budget_value, Mapping):
  197          raise _invalid_binding()
  198      if not set(context_budget_value).issubset(_DEFAULT_CONTEXT_BUDGET):
  199          raise _invalid_binding()
  200      context_budget: dict[str, int] = {}
  201      for key, default in _DEFAULT_CONTEXT_BUDGET.items():
  202          value = context_budget_value.get(key, default)
  203          if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, int) or value < 1:
  204              raise _invalid_binding()
  205          context_budget[key] = value
  206      runtime["context_budget"] = context_budget
  207      # Absent means every flag is false, which is exactly what every version
  208      # published before memory existed meant. Unknown keys are rejected rather
  209      # than ignored: a flag this build does not understand is a flag it cannot
  210      # honour, and silently running without it would be the wrong answer to give
  211      # a spec that asked for it.
  212      memory_value = runtime_value.get("memory", _DEFAULT_MEMORY)
  213      if not isinstance(memory_value, Mapping):
  214          raise _invalid_binding()
  215      allowed_memory_keys = set(_DEFAULT_MEMORY) | {"max_memory_tokens"}
  216      if schema_version in {3, 4, 5}:
  217          allowed_memory_keys.add("max_memory_tokens_source")
  218      if not set(memory_value).issubset(allowed_memory_keys):
  219          raise _invalid_binding()
  220      memory: dict[str, bool] = {}
  221      for key, default in _DEFAULT_MEMORY.items():
  222          value = memory_value.get(key, default)
  223          if not isinstance(value, bool):
  224              raise _invalid_binding()
  225          memory[key] = value
  226      max_memory_tokens = memory_value.get("max_memory_tokens")
  227      if max_memory_tokens is not None and (
  228          isinstance(max_memory_tokens, bool)
  229          or not isinstance(max_memory_tokens, int)
  230          or max_memory_tokens < 1
  231      ):
  232          raise _invalid_binding()
  233      if max_memory_tokens is not None and not memory["long_term_memory"]:
  234          raise _invalid_binding()
  235      if max_memory_tokens is not None:
  236          memory["max_memory_tokens"] = max_memory_tokens
  237      memory_source = memory_value.get("max_memory_tokens_source")
  238      if schema_version in {3, 4, 5} and memory["long_term_memory"]:
  239          if (
  240              not isinstance(memory_source, str)
  241              or memory_source not in {"UNSET", "DEFAULT", "CUSTOM"}
  242              or max_memory_tokens is None
  243          ):
  244              raise _invalid_binding()
  245          memory["max_memory_tokens_source"] = memory_source
  246      elif memory_source is not None:
  247          raise _invalid_binding()
  248      runtime["memory"] = memory
  249      policy_value = runtime_value.get("context_policy")
  250      if schema_version in {3, 4, 5}:
  251          sources = runtime_value.get("context_budget_sources")
  252          if (
  253              not isinstance(sources, Mapping)
  254              or set(sources) != set(_DEFAULT_CONTEXT_BUDGET)
  255              or any(
  256                  not isinstance(source, str) or source not in {"UNSET", "DEFAULT", "CUSTOM"}
  257                  for source in sources.values()
  258              )
  259          ):
  260              raise _invalid_binding()
  261          try:
  262              runtime["context_policy"] = validate_frozen_context_policy(
  263                  policy_value,
  264                  [model, *fallback_values],
  265                  reserved_output_tokens=context_budget["reserved_output_tokens"],
  266              )
  267          except (TypeError, ValueError):
  268              raise _invalid_binding() from None
  269          runtime["context_budget_sources"] = dict(sources)
  270      elif policy_value is not None:
  271          raise _invalid_binding()
  272      history_policy = runtime_value.get("history_policy")
  273      if schema_version in {4, 5}:
  274          if history_policy != "deterministic_history_v1":
  275              raise _invalid_binding()
  276          runtime["history_policy"] = history_policy
  277      elif history_policy is not None:
  278          raise _invalid_binding()
  279      summary_policy = runtime_value.get("summary_policy")
  280      if schema_version == 5:
  281          runtime["summary_policy"] = _parse_summary_policy(summary_policy, primary=primary)
  282      elif summary_policy is not None:
  283          raise _invalid_binding()
  284      return FrozenAgentSpec(
  285          model_plan=ResolvedModelExecutionPlan(
  286              primary=primary,
  287              fallbacks=fallbacks,
  288              retry_policy=retry_policy,
  289          ),
  290          system_prompt=system_prompt,
  291          prompt_version=prompt_version,
  292          runtime=runtime,
  293          knowledge_bindings=knowledge_bindings,
  294          wiki_binding=wiki_binding,
  295      )

121  async def search_knowledge(
  122      context: ToolExecutionContext,
  123      definition: ToolDefinition,
  124      arguments: Mapping[str, Any],
  125      session_factory: ToolSessionFactory | None,
  126      *,
  127      retriever: KnowledgeRetriever | None,
  128      section_selector: SectionSelector | None = None,
  129  ) -> dict[str, Any]:
  130      if session_factory is None or retriever is None:
  131          raise ToolHandlerError("TOOL_EXECUTION_FAILED", "The knowledge search is unavailable.")
  132      text = arguments.get("query")
  133      if not isinstance(text, str) or not text.strip() or len(text) > _MAX_QUERY_LENGTH:
  134          raise ToolHandlerError("SEARCH_INVALID_ARGUMENT", "The search query is invalid.")
  135      # A ceiling, not a target: the projection drops whatever the evidence
  136      # budget cannot carry as a complete record (FIX-06).
  137      limit = arguments.get("limit", 10)
  138      if isinstance(limit, bool) or not isinstance(limit, int) or not 1 <= limit <= _MAX_RESULTS:
  139          raise ToolHandlerError("SEARCH_INVALID_ARGUMENT", "The result limit is invalid.")
  140      mismatches = retrieval_model_identity_mismatches(definition.retrieval_config, retriever)
  141      if mismatches:
  142          raise ToolHandlerError(
  143              "KNOWLEDGE_MODEL_IDENTITY_DRIFT",
  144              "The published retrieval model is not the deployed model.",
  145          )
  146      if (
  147          getattr(definition, "retrieval_config", None)
  148          and definition.retrieval_config.get("evidence_set_selector") == "onyx_v1"
  149      ):
  150          # Version-level opt-in: the wrapped retriever owns the fail-closed
  151          # fallback to the original ranking when the selector is missing or
  152          # fails, so an unconfigured deployment degrades to baseline, never
  153          # to an error the agent would read as "nothing found".
  154          retriever = OnyxSelectionKnowledgeRetriever(retriever, section_selector)
  155  
  156      async with session_factory() as session:
  157          queries = await _snapshot_queries(session, context, definition, text=text, limit=limit)
  158  
  159      evidence = []
  160      for query in queries:
  161          result = await retriever.retrieve_with_trace(_retrieval_context(context), query)
  162          if not isinstance(result, RetrievalResult):
  163              raise ToolHandlerError(
  164                  "TOOL_EXECUTION_FAILED", "The knowledge search returned an invalid result."
  165              )
  166          for item in result.evidence:
  167              reference = evidence_reference(
  168                  item,
  169                  snapshot_id=query.knowledge_snapshot_id,
  170                  knowledge_base_id=query.knowledge_base_id,
  171              )
  172              evidence.append((item, reference))
  173      evidence.sort(
  174          key=lambda item: (
  175              -(
  176                  item[0].rerank_score
  177                  if item[0].rerank_score is not None
  178                  else item[0].retrieval_score
  179              ),
  180              -item[0].retrieval_score,
  181              item[0].document_revision_id,
  182              item[0].chunk_id,
  183          )
  184      )
  185      # Multi-snapshot unions can re-admit fixed-window neighbours whose overlap
  186      # a higher-ranked record already delivers; dropping them here frees result
  187      # slots for complementary passages. chunk_id hashes the revision id and
  188      # content, so one chunk_id always identifies the same passage.
  189      kept = drop_overlapping_evidence([item for item, _ in evidence])
  190      keep_ids = {item.chunk_id for item in kept}
  191      evidence = [pair for pair in evidence if pair[0].chunk_id in keep_ids]
  192      retrieval_config = getattr(definition, "retrieval_config", None) or {}
  193      include_snapshot_ids = retrieval_config.get("evidence_projection") == "compact_v1"
  194      return {
  195          "evidence_refs": [reference for _, reference in evidence[:limit]],
  196          "results": [
  197              evidence_record(
  198                  item,
  199                  snapshot_id=reference["snapshot_id"] if include_snapshot_ids else None,
  200              )
  201              for item, reference in evidence[:limit]
  202          ],
  203      }

1  """Shared source-record projection before model-facing evidence assembly."""
    2  
    3  from __future__ import annotations
    4  
    5  from collections.abc import Mapping, Sequence
    6  from typing import Any
    7  
    8  from packages.knowledge.contracts import RetrievedEvidence
    9  
   10  # The excerpt cap bounds the tool return and the private evidence registry, not
   11  # the model view: the observation projection is lossless and drops whole
   12  # records instead of truncating them. It must therefore stay at or above the
   13  # configured chunk size (default 1200 chars) so a whole chunk can survive this
   14  # cap; chunks larger than the cap lose only their tail here.
   15  MAX_EVIDENCE_EXCERPT_CHARS = 2_000
   16  
   17  
   18  def evidence_record(item: RetrievedEvidence, *, snapshot_id: str | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
   19      # Identity fields (chunk_id, document_revision_id) stay because projection
   20      # and registry pairing key on them; the model-irrelevant provenance string
   21      # and the two ranking scores were measured to cost ~180 bytes per record
   22      # of pure metadata overhead against a 5000-byte evidence pool.
   23      record = {
   24          "chunk_id": item.chunk_id,
   25          "document_id": item.document_id,
   26          "document_revision_id": item.document_revision_id,
   27          "locator": dict(item.locator),
   28          "snippet": item.text[:MAX_EVIDENCE_EXCERPT_CHARS],
   29          "document_name": item.metadata.get("document_name"),
   30          "effective_date": item.metadata.get("effective_date"),
   31          "superseded": bool(item.metadata.get("superseded", False)),
   32      }
   33      if snapshot_id is not None:
   34          record["snapshot_id"] = snapshot_id
   35      return record
   36  
   37  
   38  def evidence_reference(item: RetrievedEvidence, *, snapshot_id: str, knowledge_base_id: str):
   39      return {
   40          "snapshot_id": snapshot_id,
   41          "knowledge_base_id": knowledge_base_id,
   42          "document_revision_id": item.document_revision_id,
   43          "chunk_id": item.chunk_id,
   44      }
   45  
   46  
   47  def locator_span(locator: Any) -> tuple[int, int] | None:
   48      """Return comparable character coordinates, or None when unavailable.
   49  
   50      ``char_start``/``char_end`` are document-absolute; ``start``/``end`` are the
   51      paragraph-relative pair some sources emit. Records without usable text
   52      coordinates (for example page-only PDF locators) are never deduplicated.
   53      """
   54      if not isinstance(locator, Mapping):
   55          return None
   56      for start_key, end_key in (("char_start", "char_end"), ("start", "end")):
   57          start, end = locator.get(start_key), locator.get(end_key)
   58          if type(start) is int and type(end) is int and 0 <= start < end:
   59              return start, end
   60      return None
   61  
   62  
   63  def _span_contained(span: tuple[int, int], kept: tuple[int, int]) -> bool:
   64      return span[0] >= kept[0] and span[1] <= kept[1]
   65  
   66  
   67  class _OverlapTracker:
   68      """Keeps records whose span is not fully covered by a kept record.
   69  
   70      The judgment is containment, not mere overlap: a fixed-window neighbour
   71      ([0,1200] then [1000,2200]) carries 1000 characters no kept record
   72      covers, so dropping it on overlap alone would delete unique content and
   73      leave an 800-character gap in a consecutive window chain. Only spans
   74      entirely inside an already-kept span (exact re-deliveries, tail windows)
   75      are redundant.
   76      """
   77  
   78      def __init__(self) -> None:
   79          self._spans: dict[str, list[tuple[int, int]]] = {}
   80  
   81      def redundant(self, revision_id: Any, span: tuple[int, int] | None) -> bool:
   82          if span is None or not isinstance(revision_id, str) or not revision_id:
   83              return False
   84          return any(_span_contained(span, other) for other in self._spans.get(revision_id, ()))
   85  
   86      def keep(self, revision_id: Any, span: tuple[int, int] | None) -> None:
   87          if span is None or not isinstance(revision_id, str) or not revision_id:
   88              return
   89          self._spans.setdefault(revision_id, []).append(span)
   90  
   91  
   92  def drop_overlapping_evidence(
   93      items: Sequence[RetrievedEvidence],
   94  ) -> tuple[RetrievedEvidence, ...]:
   95      """Drop later evidence whose char span is fully contained in a kept span
   96      of the same document revision.
   97  
   98      Exact re-deliveries (multi-snapshot unions, tail windows inside a larger
   99      window) pay the budget twice for text a kept record already covers. A
  100      merely overlapping neighbour always carries unique text and is kept.
  101      Records without usable text coordinates are passed through unchanged so
  102      page-located sources keep their historical behaviour.
  103      """
  104      tracker = _OverlapTracker()
  105      kept: list[RetrievedEvidence] = []
  106      for item in items:
  107          span = locator_span(item.locator)
  108          if tracker.redundant(item.document_revision_id, span):
  109              continue
  110          tracker.keep(item.document_revision_id, span)
  111          kept.append(item)
  112      return tuple(kept)
  113  
  114  
  115  def drop_overlapping_records(
  116      records: Sequence[Any], references: Sequence[Any]
  117  ) -> tuple[list[Any], list[Any]]:
  118      """Pair-preserving overlap filter for record/reference projection inputs.
  119  
  120      Malformed shapes (mismatched lengths, non-mapping records) are returned
  121      unchanged so the downstream projection still fails closed on them.
  122      """
  123      if len(records) != len(references):
  124          return list(records), list(references)
  125      tracker = _OverlapTracker()
  126      kept_records: list[Any] = []
  127      kept_references: list[Any] = []
  128      for record, reference in zip(records, references, strict=True):
  129          if not isinstance(record, Mapping):
  130              return list(records), list(references)
  131          span = locator_span(record.get("locator"))
  132          if tracker.redundant(record.get("document_revision_id"), span):
  133              continue
  134          tracker.keep(record.get("document_revision_id"), span)
  135          kept_records.append(record)
  136          kept_references.append(reference)
  137      return kept_records, kept_references
  138  
  139  
  140  __all__ = [
  141      "MAX_EVIDENCE_EXCERPT_CHARS",
  142      "drop_overlapping_evidence",
  143      "drop_overlapping_records",
  144      "evidence_record",
  145      "evidence_reference",
  146      "locator_span",
  147  ]

265      async def revoke_source(self, session, context, kb_id, revision_id):
  266          require(context, "knowledge_edit")
  267          revision = await session.scalar(
  268              select(DocumentRevision)
  269              .where(
  270                  DocumentRevision.workspace_id == UUID(context.workspace_id),
  271                  DocumentRevision.knowledge_base_id == kb_id,
  272                  DocumentRevision.id == revision_id,
  273              )
  274              .with_for_update()
  275          )

  277              fail("DOCUMENT_REVISION_NOT_FOUND", "The source revision was not found.", 404)

  280              .values(

  283                  document_revision_id=revision_id,
  284                  revoked_by=context.user_id,
  285              )

  287          )
  288          append_audit(
  289              session,
  290              action="wiki_source_revoke",
  291              resource_type="document_revision",

  294              actor_user_id=UUID(context.user_id),
  295              workspace_id=UUID(context.workspace_id),
  296              organization_id=UUID(context.organization.organization_id),
  297              safe_metadata={"scope": "WIKI", "status": "REVOKED"},
  298          )
  299          await session.commit()

173      def __init__(
  174          self,
  175          *,
  176          sequence: int,
  177          type: AgentEventType | str,
  178          request_id: str,
  179          run_id: str,
  180          agent_version_id: str,

  197          self.type = event_type
  198          self.run_id = str(run_id)
  199          self.agent_version_id = str(agent_version_id)
  200          self.timestamp = timestamp
  201          self.payload = _validated_data(event_type, payload)

1  # ADR-008: Tool side-effect semantics
    2  
    3  Status: Accepted in M0.
    4  
    5  Tool effect, risk and approval are separate. Internal transactional tools use idempotency
    6  keys. External effects without a confirmed outcome become `UNKNOWN_OUTCOME` and are never
    7  silently retried; the corresponding Run becomes `NEEDS_ATTENTION`. Approval decision and
    8  execution status are independent state dimensions.
